theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ i, ν i univ < ∞) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ B : ℝ≥0∞, B < ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ν i (closedBall 0 R) ≤ B) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ⨆ i, ν i K < ∞
